questions.question_text: Read the unseen passage segment. According to the text, what was the primary reason the local authorities decided to implement a vertical farming initiative in the urban center?
options: A) To create more aesthetic green spaces for tourists
B) To combat the severe shortage of arable land and reduce food transport emissions
C) To provide employment exclusively for local botanists
D) To prevent migratory birds from entering the city airspace
questions.answer: B) To combat the severe shortage of arable land and reduce food transport emissions

questions.question_text: Choose the word from the passage that is the closest synonym to the term 'resilient' as used to describe the newly engineered crop varieties.
questions.answer: C) Hardy

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank based on the passage: The automated irrigation system is strictly controlled by a network of ________ that monitor soil moisture levels continuously.
questions.answer: AI-driven sensors

questions.question_text: Based on the text, why did the initial phase of the vertical farming project face resistance from the older residents? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The older residents were skeptical because they preferred traditional soil-based farming methods and doubted that crops grown in artificial urban structures could be as nutritious or flavorful.

questions.question_text: Identify and describe the two main environmental benefits of the vertical farming initiative mentioned in the third paragraph. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The initiative significantly lowers carbon emissions by eliminating long-distance food transport and conserves thousands of gallons of freshwater through its advanced closed-loop water recycling system.

questions.question_text: What underlying message does the author convey about the future of urban sustainability in the concluding paragraph? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The author suggests that true urban sustainability relies on humanity's willingness to adapt and integrate advanced green technologies to harmonize modern city life with ecological preservation.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Write a diary entry expressing your feelings after witnessing the first heavy monsoon shower following a prolonged and intensely hot summer season. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Dear Diary, Today brought sheer relief! After weeks of scorching heat, the skies finally opened up. The smell of wet earth was intoxicating, and the cool breeze instantly lifted my spirits. I spent an hour just watching the rain wash the dusty trees clean. It feels like a rebirth.

questions.question_text: Write a formal letter to your school Principal requesting permission to organize a 'Spectacular Wonders of Science' exhibition in the school auditorium next month. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Principal, I am writing on behalf of the Science Club to request permission to host a 'Spectacular Wonders of Science' exhibition in the school auditorium next month. This event will allow students to showcase innovative working models and foster a scientific temper. We assure you of maintaining complete discipline. Yours obediently, Amit.

questions.question_text: Identify the option that correctly converts the given active sentence into the Passive Voice: 'The brilliant physicist discovered a new subatomic particle.'
options: A) A new subatomic particle is discovered by the brilliant physicist.
B) A new subatomic particle was discovered by the brilliant physicist.
C) A new subatomic particle had been discovered by the brilliant physicist.
D) The brilliant physicist was discovering a new subatomic particle.
questions.answer: B) A new subatomic particle was discovered by the brilliant physicist.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct Indirect Speech transformation for the following sentence: The teacher said to the students, "The Earth revolves around the Sun."
options: A) The teacher told the students that the Earth revolved around the Sun.
B) The teacher told the students that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
C) The teacher asked the students if the Earth revolved around the Sun.
D) The teacher commanded the students that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
questions.answer: B) The teacher told the students that the Earth revolves around the Sun.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate modal of obligation: 'You ________ submit your assignment by tomorrow morning, or marks will be deducted.'
questions.answer: C) must

questions.question_text: Select the correct prepositions to fill in the blanks: 'The frightened puppy hid ________ the bed and refused to come ________.'
questions.answer: B) under / out

questions.question_text: Identify the noun clause in the following complex sentence: 'I completely understand that the upcoming science project requires immense dedication.'
options: B) that the upcoming science project requires immense dedication
questions.answer: B) that the upcoming science project requires immense dedication

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct conjunction of condition: '________ you water the cherry tree daily, it will not survive the harsh summer.'
questions.answer: B) Unless

questions.question_text: Choose the correct Indirect Speech transformation: Claribel's owner said, "I will take the bird to the space station tomorrow."
options: A) Claribel's owner said that he will take the bird to the space station tomorrow.
B) Claribel's owner said that he would take the bird to the space station the next day.
C) Claribel's owner said that he takes the bird to the space station the next day.
D) Claribel's owner told that he would take the bird to the space station tomorrow.
questions.answer: B) Claribel's owner said that he would take the bird to the space station the next day.

questions.question_text: Select the correct verb form to complete the sentence ensuring Subject-Verb Concord: 'Neither the magnifying glass nor the binoculars ________ found in the laboratory drawer.'
questions.answer: B) were

questions.question_text: Read the extract: 'It took eight years to grow. / A weed, he said, but I knew better.' Who is the poet referring to in this line from 'The Cherry Tree'?
questions.answer: A) His grandfather

questions.question_text: Read the extract: 'She was a tiny, yellow canary, and her presence made the cold metal walls feel a little more like home.' Which chapter is this extract taken from?
options: B) The Magic Brush of Dreams
questions.answer: C) Feathered Friend

questions.question_text: How does the poem 'Waiting for the Rain' vividly describe the condition of the parched earth and the farmers before the downpour begins? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The poem portrays the earth as cracked, dry, and desperate for moisture, while the farmers look up at the unforgiving, cloudless sky with weary eyes, praying for relief and survival.

questions.question_text: In the poem 'Harvest Hymn', what are the farmers expressing their profound gratitude for? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The farmers express deep gratitude for nature's generosity, celebrating the bountiful yield of golden crops that represent the successful reward of their hard labor throughout the demanding agricultural season.

questions.question_text: According to the chapter 'Bibha Chowdhuri: The Beam of Light that Lit the Path', what significant contribution did she make to the field of subatomic physics? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Bibha Chowdhuri made groundbreaking contributions by discovering the pi-meson and mu-meson particles using photographic plates exposed to cosmic rays at high altitudes in the Himalayas.

questions.question_text: In the story featuring the 'Magnifying Glass', how did the instrument alter the narrator's perception of everyday, mundane objects? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The magnifying glass revealed hidden, intricate textures and entirely new miniature worlds within ordinary things like leaves and fabric, transforming the narrator's mundane surroundings into objects of spectacular wonder.

questions.question_text: Analyze the central theme of survival and the importance of nature in the highly technological setting of 'Feathered Friend'. How does the canary save the crew? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The story contrasts cold space technology with the fragility of nature. Despite advanced sensors, it is Claribel, the small canary, who saves the crew. Because birds are highly sensitive to toxic air, her fainting alerts the astronauts to a fatal failure in the oxygen system just in time to fix it.

questions.question_text: Discuss the deep emotional significance of planting the seed in 'The Cherry Tree'. How does the tree's slow, persistent growth parallel human resilience and patience? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Planting the seed represents hope, creation, and an enduring connection to nature. The cherry tree survives goats, harsh weather, and grass-cutters through sheer resilience. Its survival and eventual blossoming parallel the human journey—demonstrating that with immense patience and resilience, one can overcome severe adversities and ultimately thrive.
